set.body: Outcome: implement the six assessed workflow improvements authorized by proceed. Scope: bounded jobs list; enforced compute queue deadline and exact-owned allocation cancellation evidence; explicit-ID persistent completion/failure subscriptions in the existing daemon; log-parent preparation; bounded error excerpts; transfer guidance. Preserve legacy foreground watch/events and unrelated activity-journal plans. This is a job-specific observation slice, not completion of the broader WP8a activity journal/campaign monitoring epic. Invariants: no false cleanup or completion claims, no observer workload mutation, bounded response and polling budgets, explicit unavailable states. Checks: regressions using FakeSlurm and daemon integration; full pytest, Ruff, mypy, stub compatibility and package build. No deployment or live allocation required.
set.title: Harden long-job workflows: bounded listings, owned compute cleanup, job subscriptions and logs
